scientific_integrity: A direct proof establishes all infinite parameter cases; a standalone graph-level script checks finite boundaries and independent constructive instances. Previously known scalar domination bounds and the established cycle value are explicitly credited. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The classification and count concern minimum-weight outer-independent two-rainbow functions of categorical products of two complete graphs with factor orders at least two. They do not enumerate nonoptimal functions, quotient by symmetries, or address other graph products. Independent mathematical audit and publication-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Exact optimal outer-independent two-rainbow labelings of products of cliques
